changes.comment: BREAKING: JsonSchema.fromJson resolves local $ref (#/$defs/…, #/definitions/…, any #/… pointer) by inlining, bounded at 32 nested and 1000 total expansions, 100000 schema nodes and 128 levels of nesting per conversion (failing with a Result rather than exhausting the stack); pointers are percent-decoded before splitting, per RFC 6901; toJson() emits the inlined, reference-free schema. Remote refs, anchors, recursive schemas, refs beside validation keywords, and refs under or through a nested $id are refused with the keyword and path named. Newly refused, where they were previously accepted: $dynamicRef and $recursiveRef (were silently ignored), a declared property named __proto__ (its schema was silently lost), and any schema over 100000 nodes.
